ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, with (preposition) · 'where' as a place conjunction (ኀበ ትነብር 'where she dwells'; ch. 17–19 headings)
ነጋዲ: ነጋዲ — merchant, trader (noun; agent noun of ነገደ; plural ነጋድያን)
ተምሪን: ተምሪን — Tamrin (proper name; spelling of the body of ch. 22, the heading has ታምሪን)
ወሖረ: ሖረ — and he went (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
ለሰሎሞን: ሰሎሞን — Solomon (proper name; ለ- naming the possessor 'Solomon's')
ወሰገደ: ሰገደ — and he bowed down (ወ- + 3ms perfect, s-g-d)
ሎቱ: ለ — to him, for him (preposition ለ- with 3m sg suffix -tu: ሎቱ)
ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man')
እምእለ: እለ — more than those who (እም- comparative + relative pronoun)
ወይገብሩ: ገብረ — and they make (ወ- 'and' + 3mp imperfect, G, g-b-r)
በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
ላቲ: ለ — for her (preposition ለ- with 3fs suffix ላቲ)
ወወሀቦ: ወሀበ — and he gave him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-h-b + -ኦ 'him')
ዘይትፈቀድ: ተፈቀደ — what is needed, required (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect passive of ፈቀደ)
ክብረ: ክብር — glory, honour (construct 'glory of') · accusative 'glory' (ወሀቦሙ ክብረ 'he gave them glory')
ወወፅአ: ወፅአ — and he went out (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-ṣ-ʾ)
ወበጽሐ: በጽሐ — and he reached (ወ- + 3ms perfect, b-ṣ-ḥ)
ወዘከመ: ዘከመ — and how, in the way that (ወ- 'and' + ዘከመ, ዘ- + ከመ)
ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
በኀቤሁ: ኀበ — from him, with him (በ- + ኀቤሁ 'to him'; sense 'from him' preferred, 'to him' possible) (?)
እምነ: እምነ — from (preposition, እምነ before a noun)
ነጋድያን: ነጋዲ — merchants (noun, plural of ነጋዲ; as in ሊቀ ነጋድያን 'chief of merchants')
ይሠርዕ: ሠርዐ — he orders, sets in order (3ms imperfect, G)
ወየሐውሩ: ሖረ — and they go (ወ- 'and' + 3mp imperfect, G, ḥ-w-r)
ለእለ: እለ — to those who (ለ- 'to' + relative pronoun pl.)
ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
በኀበ: ኀበ — before, with, in the presence of (በ- + ኀበ) · among (በኀበ ማእምራን 'among the knowing')
በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that')
ትሖር: ሖረ — that she go (3fs, after ከመ; the imperfect shape ትሖር)
ትስማዕ: ሰምዐ — that she may hear (3fs subjunctive, after ከመ)
ጥበቢሁ: ጥበብ — his wisdom (noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his'; the suffix anticipates the possessor named with ለ-)
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as, up to (preposition)
ወይንሥኡ: ነሥአ — and that they take (ወ- + 3mpl subjunctive, G)
